energy_accounting.study_energy_disclosure: Datasheet schedules and cold-chain battery simulations; physical board unmetered.

claims.statement: Give a computer a strict energy budget upfront, and design it to deliver the best verified answer inside that limit.
A food-freshness sensor tag can budget a coin battery for eight years and drop routine chatter in freezing cargo so critical alerts survive.
At the other extreme, a data center can follow power-grid caps by pausing flexible jobs and matching human reading speed.
Headline outcome: 8-Yr Coin-Cell Schedule · 100% Cold Alerts Saved (Datasheet schedules and cold-chain battery simulations; physical board unmetered.)

easy_read.easy_title: Computers That Respect a Strict Battery Budget
three_points_one_idea_sentences: This study is about computers that respect a strict battery budget.
Give a computer a strict energy budget upfront, and design it to deliver the best verified answer inside that limit.
A food-freshness sensor tag can budget a coin battery for eight years and drop routine chatter in freezing cargo so critical alerts survive.
At the other extreme, a data center can follow power-grid caps by pausing flexible jobs and matching human reading speed.
Key result: 8-Yr Coin-Cell Schedule · 100% Cold Alerts Saved.
Clear math and public price records checked every number.
